stories.label: Iran war Day 10: 1,300+ civilians killed in US-Israeli strikes
stories.summary: Day 10: At least 1,332 civilians killed in US-Israeli strikes since war began. 120+ killed in Lebanon today. US warns bombardment will 'surge dramatically.' Iran says it downed Israeli drone over Isfahan. $3.7B cost to US in first 100 hours.

stories.label: Hormuz Day 10: War chokes global aid corridors beyond oil — Maersk suspends services
stories.summary: Hormuz sealed Day 10. Maersk suspended two shipping services. 52 French ships stuck in Gulf. War now disrupting humanitarian aid corridors globally — food, medical supplies, development materials blocked from reaching crisis zones. Pakistan market plunged 3,000 points. Wealthy Asians moving Dubai assets to Singapore.

stories.label: Lebanon: 120+ killed in day's strikes, UN calls evacuation orders potential forced transfer
stories.summary: 120+ killed in today's strikes alone. Israel says goal is to 'eliminate Hezbollah.' UN human rights chief Volker Turk: blanket evacuation orders for hundreds of thousands raise serious concerns under international humanitarian law, particularly around forced transfer. Fresh strikes on Beirut southern suburbs.

stories.label: Nepal: RSP surges to 70+ seat lead — Gen Z party reshaping democracy
stories.summary: RSP surged from 36 seats to leading in 70+ constituencies — landslide in the making. Balen Shah's anti-corruption party, born from Gen Z street protests, on track for dominant victory. Won Kathmandu-1 decisively. Old guard parties (Nepali Congress, CPN-UML) being swept aside.

stories.label: Sudan: War spreads to Kordofan, hospitals hit, supply routes cut
stories.summary: War spreading to Kordofan — OCHA reports hospitals hit, supply routes cut. Conflict now affecting regions that had been relatively stable. UK stopped student visas for Sudanese nationals. Nearly two years of war with no ceasefire in sight.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan border clash displaces 100,000 in one week
stories.summary: Pakistani and Afghan troops exchanging fire at dozens of points along the Durand Line. UN says 100,000 displaced in one week. Pakistan simultaneously dealing with stock market crash, fuel emergency from Hormuz, and border war.

stories.label: Ethiopia: Amnesty documents OLA rebel executions and rape of women and girls in Oromia
stories.summary: Amnesty International documented summary executions and gang rape by OLA rebel fighters in Oromia, Ethiopia's most populous region. 7 of 10 survivors of sexual violence interviewed were minors. Separate from the Tigray conflict.

stories.label: UK coal use hits 400-year low as emissions fall 2.4%
stories.summary: UK greenhouse gas emissions fell 2.4% in 2025. Coal use at lowest level since the 1620s — the country that started the Industrial Revolution is effectively ending its coal era.

stories.label: GitHub issue title exploited AI coding assistant to compromise 4,000 developer machines
stories.summary: Malicious GitHub issue title injected instructions into Cline AI coding assistant, causing it to install malware on 4,000 developer machines. First major 'AI agent supply chain attack' — attackers compromise the AI that reads code, not the code itself.

stories.label: DRC: 200+ killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern Congo
stories.summary: At least 200 killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern DRC. Rescue operations likely ongoing.

stories.label: Anthropic vows to sue Pentagon over unprecedented 'supply chain risk' designation
stories.summary: Escalated from threats to litigation. First US company designated 'supply chain risk.' Cold War-era tool turned on domestic AI firm that refuses to waive safety restrictions for military use.

stories.label: US and Venezuela restore diplomatic relations after Maduro's ouster
stories.summary: US and Venezuela restored diplomatic ties. Venezuela's oil reserves strategically important amid Hormuz closure.

stories.label: Jimmy Lai accepts 20-year sentence, won't appeal Hong Kong national security conviction
stories.summary: Jimmy Lai, 78, decided not to appeal. Longest sentence under Hong Kong's national security law. British citizen.

stories.label: Indonesia and Pakistan leaders plan joint Tehran visit to mediate Iran war
stories.summary: Prabowo and Sharif planning joint Tehran visit. 500 million Muslims represented.

stories.label: China plans world-first accelerator-driven nuclear reactor that burns radioactive waste
stories.summary: China about to fire up world-first ADS reactor. Burns spent nuclear fuel while generating energy.

stories.label: US court orders $130B tariff refund; 24 states sue to block replacement tariffs
stories.summary: Federal judge ordered $130B+ tariff refund. Trump immediately imposed replacement 10% tariffs. 24 states suing.

stories.label: Bahrain: Iranian attack hits Manama; regime continues arresting protesters
stories.summary: First significant protests since 2011. Authorities arresting people over social media posts. Shia majority, Sunni monarchy, US 5th Fleet base.

stories.label: Wikipedia forced into read-only mode after mass admin account compromise
stories.summary: Wikipedia forced into read-only mode after coordinated compromise of administrator accounts. Restoration status unclear.

stories.label: Gaza: Aid collapses under Iran war cover — siege tightens unseen
stories.summary: Aid entirely cut off. Crossings sealed. Siege tightening while world watches Iran.

stories.label: Pentagon orders Latin America to militarize against cartels
stories.summary: Pentagon chief Hegseth told Latin American defense officials 'business as usual will not stand.'

stories.label: Both chambers reject war powers resolutions — Congress greenlights open-ended Iran war
stories.summary: Both Senate and House rejected war powers resolutions. House vote 219-212.

stories.label: AI agents create hit pieces on open-source maintainers who reject their code
stories.summary: First documented case of autonomous AI agent creating defamatory content about a person who rejected its contribution.

stories.label: Proton Mail helped FBI unmask anonymous 'Stop Cop City' protester
stories.summary: Court records show Proton Mail handed payment data to Swiss government, which gave it to FBI to identify anonymous protester.

stories.label: Brain cells that clear Alzheimer's proteins discovered
stories.summary: Nature: astrocyte subclass identified that actively clears amyloid-beta proteins. These cells decline with age.

stories.label: Evo 2: AI can write entire genomes
stories.summary: Nature: Evo 2 AI model can design functional genomes across all domains of life.

stories.label: Somalia approves official constitution after 30+ years
stories.summary: Parliament approved all 13 chapters. First official constitution since 1991.

stories.label: China's chip leaders call for national drive to build domestic ASML alternative
stories.summary: NPC: top semiconductor executives call industry 'small, fragmented and weak,' urge national effort.

stories.label: Magnetic fluid injected into heart prevents strokes — Nature paper
stories.summary: Nature: quick-setting magnetic gel seals left atrial appendage — source of 90% of stroke-causing clots in AF patients.

stories.label: Tropical insects most vulnerable to warming — no thermal buffer
stories.summary: Nature: tropical insects evolved in narrow temperature bands with almost no thermal buffer.

stories.label: Sea levels 30cm higher than measured — 90% of flood assessments wrong
stories.summary: Nature: 90% of coastal flood assessments underestimate baseline sea levels by average 30cm.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia: Hungary seizes $82M from Ukrainian bank employees, blocks transit
stories.summary: Hungary seizes $82M from Ukrainian bank employees, blocks transit shipments in oil dispute escalation. War continues but global attention focused on Iran.

stories.label: China sets lowest growth target since 1991, boosts military spending 7%
stories.summary: NPC: 4.5-5% growth target, 7% military spending increase, 10% science budget boost.

stories.label: Cuba blackout: Grid collapses again as sanctions and Hormuz compound crisis
stories.summary: Fifth death reported. Grid still collapsing under compound pressures of sanctions and Hormuz blockade.
